tools.description: Attach a local file (max 10MB) to a transaction. Allowed types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/heic, image/heif, application/pdf. The file is read from the local filesystem of the host running this MCP server.

content_type.description: MIME type. If omitted, the server infers it from the file extension.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file on the local filesystem.

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction to attach the file to.

tools.name: attach_file_to_transaction

tools.description: Create a new category or a category group. Set is_group=true to create a category group; supply children as an array of existing category IDs and/or strings (names of new sub-categories to create).

archived.description: Whether the category should be archived.

children.description: Only valid when is_group is true. Array of existing category IDs (numbers) and/or names of new sub-categories to create (strings).

exclude_from_budget.description: Whether transactions in this category should be excluded from budgets.

exclude_from_totals.description: Whether transactions in this category should be excluded from calculated totals.

group_id.description: If set, assigns the new category to an existing category group. Cannot be set if is_group is true.

is_group.description: If true, creates a category group instead of a category. When true, group_id may not be set; use children to assign existing categories.

is_income.description: Whether transactions in this category should be treated as income.

tools.name: create_category

tools.description: Create a new manually-managed account. (Formerly `create_asset`.)

balance_as_of.description: Date or datetime the balance is as of (ISO 8601).

closed_on.description: Date the account was closed (YYYY-MM-DD). If set, status is forced to closed.

currency.description: Three-letter lowercase currency code (defaults to primary currency).

display_name.description: Display name. If unset, derived from institution_name and name.

exclude_from_transactions.description: If true, transactions cannot be assigned to this account.

institution_name.description: Name of the institution holding the account.

type.description: Primary type of the manual account.

tools.name: create_manual_account

tools.description: Create a new tag.

archived.description: If true, the tag is created archived.

background_color.description: Optional background color of the tag.

text_color.description: Optional text color of the tag.

tools.name: create_tag

tools.description: Create a transaction group from 2-500 existing transactions. Source transactions are hidden from get_transactions and accessible via the new group's `children` (set include_children=true on get_single_transaction). Cannot include split or recurring transactions.

category_id.description: Category for the group. If unset and all children share a category, the group inherits it.

date.description: Date for the new grouped transaction (YYYY-MM-DD).

ids.description: IDs of existing transactions to group together.

payee.description: Payee for the new grouped transaction.

status.description: Status for the new grouped transaction. Defaults to reviewed.

tag_ids.description: Tag IDs to apply to the new group.

tools.name: create_transaction_group

tools.description: Insert one or more transactions (1-500 per call). Returns inserted transactions plus any skipped duplicates.

apply_rules.description: Apply rules associated with the transaction's manual_account_id.

skip_balance_update.description: If true, do not update the manual account's balance when inserting these transactions.

skip_duplicates.description: Flag transactions that match an existing transaction's date+payee+amount+account as duplicates and skip them. Note: external_id deduplication always runs regardless of this flag.

amount.description: Numeric value (no currency symbol). Positive = debit, negative = credit. Up to 4 decimal places.

currency.description: Three-letter lowercase currency code (defaults to primary currency).

manual_account_id.description: Manual account ID. Mutually exclusive with plaid_account_id.

plaid_account_id.description: Plaid account ID. Mutually exclusive with manual_account_id.

tools.name: create_transactions

tools.description: Delete a single category or category group. By default fails (HTTP 422) if dependencies exist, returning a structured `dependents` payload. Set force=true to delete and disassociate from all related budgets, transactions, recurring items, etc. Force delete is irreversible.

category_id.description: Id of the category or category group to delete.

force.description: If true, force deletion even if dependencies exist (irreversible).

tools.name: delete_category

tools.description: Delete a manually-managed account. Optionally also delete its transactions/rules/recurring items, and/or its balance history. Both deletion options are irreversible.

accountId.description: Id of the manual account to delete.

delete_balance_history.description: If true, also deletes any balance history associated with this account.

delete_items.description: If true, also deletes any transactions, rules, and recurring items associated with this account.

tools.name: delete_manual_account

tools.description: Delete a tag. By default fails (HTTP 422) with a structured `dependents` payload if the tag is in use by transactions or rules. Set force=true to delete and disassociate from those records.

force.description: If true, force deletion even if dependencies exist (irreversible).

tagId.description: Id of the tag to delete.

tools.name: delete_tag

tools.description: Delete a single transaction. Fails for split/group transactions and their parents — unsplit/ungroup first. Irreversible.

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction to delete.

tools.name: delete_transaction

tools.description: Delete a transaction file attachment. Irreversible.

file_id.description: ID of the file attachment to delete.

tools.name: delete_transaction_attachment

tools.description: Delete (ungroup) a transaction group. The original child transactions remain and revert to normal ungrouped transactions.

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction group (the group parent transaction) to delete.

tools.name: delete_transaction_group

tools.description: Bulk-delete transactions by ID (1-500). Fails if any ID is a split or group parent, or part of a split/group; unsplit or ungroup those first. Irreversible.

ids.description: Array of transaction IDs to delete (1-500).

tools.name: delete_transactions_bulk

tools.description: Get a list of all categories associated with the user's account. Returns categories in alphabetical order.

format.description: If `flattened`, returns a singular array of categories. If `nested`, returns top-level categories (either category groups or categories not part of a category group) in an array, with subcategories nested within the category group under the property children. Defaults to flattened.

is_group.description: If true, returns only category groups. If false, returns only categories that are not category groups.

tools.name: get_all_categories

tools.description: Get a list of cryptocurrency holdings. v2 has no dedicated /crypto endpoint; this tool queries /manual_accounts and filters to accounts with type=cryptocurrency. Use create_manual_account / update_manual_account / delete_manual_account for full management.
tools.name: get_all_crypto

tools.description: Get a list of all manually-managed accounts associated with the user. (Formerly known as `assets` in the v1 API.)
tools.name: get_all_manual_accounts

tools.description: Get a list of all Plaid (synced) accounts associated with the user.
tools.name: get_all_plaid_accounts

tools.description: Get a list of all tags associated with the user's account.
tools.name: get_all_tags

tools.description: Get budget period and display settings for the account (granularity, period length, anchor date, hide-no-activity preference, income option, rollover-left-to-budget setting).
tools.name: get_budget_settings

tools.description: Get a summary of the user's budget for a specified date range. Returns per-category totals (other_activity, recurring_activity, budgeted, available, recurring_remaining, recurring_expected). Set include_occurrences=true for a per-period breakdown matching the account's budget periodicity. (Backed by the v2 GET /summary endpoint.)

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. For aligned results use a valid budget period end (e.g. last day of month).

include_exclude_from_budgets.description: Include categories that have the 'Exclude from Budgets' flag set in the returned categories array.

include_occurrences.description: Include an `occurrences` array on each category, with one entry per budget period in the range.

include_past_budget_dates.description: Include the three budget occurrences prior to start_date in `occurrences`. Ignored unless include_occurrences is also true.

include_rollover_pool.description: Include a `rollover_pool` section summarizing the current rollover pool balance and previous adjustments.

include_totals.description: Include a top-level `totals` section summarizing inflow and outflow across all transactions in the range.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. For aligned results use a valid budget period start (e.g. first day of month).

tools.name: get_budget_summary

tools.description: Retrieve a list of recurring items expected for a specified date range. The `matches` object on each item is populated based on the requested range.

end_date.description: End of the range used to populate `matches` (YYYY-MM-DD). Required if start_date is set.

include_suggested.description: If true, also returns recurring items suggested by the system that have not yet been reviewed.

start_date.description: Start of the range used to populate `matches` (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the current month. Required if end_date is set.

tools.name: get_recurring_items

tools.description: Get details on a single category or category group, including the list of children categories for category groups.

categoryId.description: Id of the category to query. Call get_all_categories first to discover ids.

tools.name: get_single_category

tools.description: Get details of a single manual account by ID.

accountId.description: Id of the manual account to query. Call get_all_manual_accounts first to discover ids.

tools.name: get_single_manual_account

tools.description: Get details of a single Plaid (synced) account by ID.

accountId.description: Id of the Plaid account to query. Call get_all_plaid_accounts first to discover ids.

tools.name: get_single_plaid_account

tools.description: Retrieve a single recurring item by ID. Optional date range populates the `matches` object.

end_date.description: End of the range used to populate `matches` (YYYY-MM-DD). Required if start_date is set.

recurringId.description: Id of the recurring item to query. Call get_recurring_items first to discover ids.

start_date.description: Start of the range used to populate `matches` (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the current month. Required if end_date is set.

tools.name: get_single_recurring_item

tools.description: Get details of a single tag by ID.

tagId.description: Id of the tag to query. Call get_all_tags first to discover ids.

tools.name: get_single_tag

tools.description: Get details of a specific transaction. The response always includes plaid_metadata, custom_metadata, files, and (for split or group parents) the children array — none of which are returned by default in get_transactions.

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction to retrieve.

tools.name: get_single_transaction

tools.description: Get a short-lived signed download URL for a transaction file attachment. The response includes the URL and an `expires_at` timestamp.
tools.name: get_transaction_attachment_url

tools.description: Retrieve transactions, optionally filtered by date range, account, category, tag, recurring item, status, and more. Returns at most `limit` transactions (default 1000, max 2000); `has_more` is set on the response when more match the filters. Pending and split-parent / group-child transactions are excluded by default.

category_id.description: Filter by category ID. 0 returns only un-categorized transactions. Matches both leaf categories and category groups.

created_since.description: Only return transactions created after this timestamp.

end_date.description: End of the date range. Required if start_date is set.

include_children.description: Populate the `children` array on group/split parent transactions.

include_files.description: Include the `files` array (attachment metadata) on each transaction.

include_group_children.description: Include the original transactions that were combined into transaction groups.

include_metadata.description: Include plaid_metadata and custom_metadata fields on each transaction.

include_pending.description: Include imported pending transactions in results.

include_split_parents.description: Include the original parent transactions of split transactions.

is_group_parent.description: If true, returns only transaction groups (group parents).

is_pending.description: Filter by pending status. Takes precedence over include_pending when set.

manual_account_id.description: Filter by manual account ID, or 0 to omit all manual-account transactions.

offset.description: Offset for pagination. Use with `has_more` from a previous response.

plaid_account_id.description: Filter by Plaid account ID, or 0 to omit all Plaid-account transactions.

start_date.description: Beginning of the date range. Required if end_date is set.

updated_since.description: Only return transactions updated after this timestamp.

tools.name: get_transactions

tools.description: Get details on the current user
tools.name: get_user

tools.description: Remove the budget for a specific category and period. The request is idempotent — succeeds even if no budget exists for the period.

category_id.description: Category ID for the budget to remove.

start_date.description: Budget period start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be a valid budget period start.

tools.name: remove_budget

tools.description: Split an existing transaction into 2-500 child transactions. The sum of child amounts must equal the parent's amount. After splitting, the parent is hidden from get_transactions and accessible via get_single_transaction (returns the parent with `children`).

child_transactions.description: Children to create. Sum of amounts must equal the parent's amount.

amount.description: Amount of this split. Sum of all children must equal the parent's amount.

category_id.description: Category ID. Defaults to parent's category. Cannot be a category group.

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction to split.

tools.name: split_transaction

tools.description: Trigger a fetch of latest data from Plaid. Optionally scope the fetch to a date range and/or a specific Plaid account ID. Note: Plaid enforces a minimum 60-second delay between fetch requests; fetching may take up to 5 minutes.

end_date.description: End of the date range to fetch transactions for (YYYY-MM-DD). Required if start_date is set.

id.description: If set, only fetch the specified Plaid account; otherwise all eligible accounts are fetched.

start_date.description: Beginning of the date range to fetch transactions for (YYYY-MM-DD). Required if end_date is set.

tools.name: trigger_plaid_fetch

tools.description: Unsplit a previously split transaction by deleting its children and restoring the parent. Pass the parent (split_parent_id) — not a child — as the path id.

transaction_id.description: ID of the previously split parent transaction. Use the split_parent_id of a split child to find it.

tools.name: unsplit_transaction

tools.description: Update properties for an existing category or category group. For category groups, supplying children replaces the group's full child list. Cannot be used to convert between category and category group.

categoryId.description: Id of the category or category group to update.

children.description: Only valid for category groups. Replaces the group's full children list. Existing IDs (numbers) keep/move categories; strings create new sub-categories.

group_id.description: Move this category into the specified category group, or null to remove from any group.

tools.name: update_category

tools.description: Update an existing manually-managed account. (Formerly `update_asset`.)

accountId.description: Id of the manual account to update.

tools.name: update_manual_account

tools.description: Update a manually-managed cryptocurrency account's balance. v2 has no dedicated /crypto/manual endpoint; this tool calls PUT /manual_accounts/{id}. The id must reference an account with type=cryptocurrency.

balance.description: Updated balance of the crypto account.

crypto_id.description: ID of the manual account (with type=cryptocurrency) to update.

tools.name: update_manual_crypto

tools.description: Update properties for an existing tag.

tagId.description: Id of the tag to update.

tools.name: update_tag

tools.description: Update an existing transaction. Provide any subset of writable fields directly (the v2 API no longer wraps the body in a `transaction` envelope). Cannot modify split or grouped transactions; use the corresponding split/group tools instead.

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction to update.

update.description: Fields to update. Provide at least one writable field.

additional_tag_ids.description: Adds these tags to the existing transaction tags. Mutually exclusive with tag_ids.

tag_ids.description: Replaces all existing tags on the transaction. Mutually exclusive with additional_tag_ids.

update_balance.description: Defaults to true. Pass false to skip updating the associated manual account's balance.

tools.name: update_transaction

tools.description: Update multiple transactions in a single call (1-500). Each entry must include `id` plus at least one writable field. Cannot be used to modify split or grouped transactions.

transactions.description: Array of partial transaction updates, each keyed by its `id`.

additional_tag_ids.description: Adds these tags to the existing transaction tags. Mutually exclusive with tag_ids.

id.description: ID of the transaction to update (required).

tag_ids.description: Replaces all existing tags on the transaction. Mutually exclusive with additional_tag_ids.

tools.name: update_transactions_bulk

tools.description: Create or update a budget for a category and budget period. The start_date must be a valid budget period start for the account (see get_budget_settings).

currency.description: Three-letter lowercase currency code (defaults to primary currency).

notes.description: Optional notes for the budget period.

start_date.description: Budget period start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be a valid budget period start; if not, the API returns the previous and next valid start dates.

tools.name: upsert_budget
